analysis_plan.primary_unit: one semantic scenario represented by one exact three-part profile answer
analysis_plan.official_interval: the ainglish-panel 0.2.32 bootstrap 95% interval over real scenario items
analysis_plan.status_error: chosen profile places X in the wrong candidate/current-path state
analysis_plan.force_false_positive: chosen profile says the recipient is required or allowed to act
analysis_plan.warrant_accuracy: fraction choosing the frozen role-ledger audit answer
analysis_plan.misapplied_standing_false_credit: on decision-by/misapplied-standing only, fraction choosing claim matches the ledger
pooling_rules: proposal-by and decision-by are separate official rows
carrier strata are reported even when the per-form scalar pools carriers
